t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice I have been given is that the previous player found that the highest points were warded when gnomes of earthly tone colours such as brown, green or yellow. However other colours such as blue or pink the points were lower. The previous player has cautioned that I should experiment to see if this theory is true by chosing a gnome colour when the x5 points show which will give me a better indication if his theory is correct to my game.

vb_textbox.text: The advice I was given I followed to the T however I found my experience to be different to theirs. The suggestion was the x5 points were higher when you selected a gnome which had earth tones such as yellow or green. The lower points were attached to the bright colours such as red and blue. I found this to be not true for me. I felt choosing any colour had no effect on the score. The main aim is just to be the fastest finger first. Regardless of the points you need to be vigilant and nimble fingered to quickly press the S, K or space bar. After a while you start to daze off put sit right up back onto the chair and keep focused. I skipped past having the full breaks I used about 45 seconds of rest time.
